name: greenwood
description: Greenwood: a game index for Robinhood Chain that screens whether a listing is a real build or a ticker with art. Live chain data, public API, MCP server.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter @greenwood/core build && pnpm -r --filter @greenwood/mcp build && pnpm --filter @greenwood/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @greenwood/core test && pnpm --filter @greenwood/mcp test && pnpm --filter @greenwood/web test
